purpose: Evaluate the owner-proposed temporary whole-application self-hosting on the existing Mac; local disposable readiness work only.
determination: RECOMMENDED TEMPORARY PLACEMENT — LOCAL PRODUCTION BOOT VERIFIED; CUTOVER NOT READY

recommended_shape.web: Run the existing Next.js production application with next start in one supervised container on the existing general Mac host. It serves GALX Media, Connect and the scoped Nova resource.
recommended_shape.private_execution: Keep the existing Premium runtime/monitor and provider credentials in their current isolated daemon. The web container receives only its own existing server configuration; do not give it or the browser the provider desktop authority.
recommended_shape.data: Keep existing Supabase identity/database and object storage. No data migration, second account system or new entitlement policy.
recommended_shape.public_path: Use the existing Cloudflare Tunnel with explicit galx.ai/www behavior and narrowly scoped nova.galx.ai routes. Preserve the existing issuer/audience/callback URLs. No DNS or ingress change performed.
recommended_shape.financial: No new hosting subscription or Vercel plan change. Existing data/provider/network/electricity usage and limits remain.

simplification.removes: The requirement to split the application for Hobby and author a bespoke persistent Nova request adapter solely to escape Vercel invocation lifetime.
simplification.keeps: Nova existing execution helper, authorization, admission, after registration and 300-second deadline. Next start owns the standard Node request lifecycle.
simplification.limits: Whole-app self-hosting does not remove edge read limits or add crash-durable output. Streaming, bounded client aggregation, quiet-stream keepalives and no replay still need end-to-end acceptance.

actual_probe.mode: next start production; unchanged retained clean-build output mounted read-only
actual_probe.network: none; loopback probes inside container only
actual_probe.limits: Idle shutdown only; active inference, real accounts, real storage, ARM64 package and public cutover not accepted by this smoke probe.

power.limits: AC idle-sleep prevention does not promise closed-lid, outage or forced-sleep availability.

interpretation: The unchanged clean-build Next application serves the home page and browser script, exposes the disabled Connect page, returns sanitized 503 for disabled authorization/resource/inference endpoints, and denies the private incident path.
Idle SIGTERM completed in 58 ms. This does not certify active-request drain, host reboot, sleep/wake recovery, public traffic or real provider inference.
Observed process RSS was 381560 KiB under x86-64 emulation on the Mac. This is one smoke snapshot, not a capacity or production-memory guarantee.

The existing AC keep-awake supervisor is active; the one-minute idle-sleep configuration is currently countered by its assertion. Do not change global power settings based only on that configuration reading.
The generic repository Dockerfile is not a proven self-hosted release procedure. The smoke test reused retained clean-build output and did not rebuild or install a candidate.

bounded_next_steps.action: Retain an immutable self-hosted package from the accepted source/build with explicit runtime dependencies, static assets and configuration; include no private guides, source workspace or secrets. Existing tested Linux x86-64 output may be rehearsed under emulation; a native ARM64 rebuild is a separately identified artifact if chosen, not silently substituted.

Stage one disabled web container on loopback, outside the provider daemon, with restricted authority, bounded memory/logs, a health check and automatic restart. Run Node directly so SIGTERM reaches the server; allow at least the existing full request lifetime plus bounded terminal I/O before forced stop.

Verify exact hosted domains/callbacks, Media/Auth/assets and storage behavior, full 300-second Nova stream/deadline, quiet-stream keepalive, bounded client aggregation, active shutdown, current-grant revocation, duplicate/no-replay and public response/asset boundaries.
Capture current DNS/ingress/serving artifacts and define rollback. Keep Connect disabled, explicit grants authoritative and cohort closed throughout preparation.
Perform public hostname cutover and cohort opening only under the separately authorized rollout. Observe the supervised Mac availability; retain prior artifacts and unchanged database history.

unresolved.item: A retained self-hosted package, full-path transport/client acceptance, new-process supervision and configuration/rollback proof are still required.
Existing authentication/recovery gates and ACT-043 remain independent; a Mac host does not close them.

unresolved.classification: NON-BLOCKING FOLLOW-UP FOR A SUPERVISED COHORT
unresolved.item: Single owner Mac remains dependent on power, wake state, user sign-in and internet. No independent always-on availability is claimed.

references.claim: Production Node/Docker hosting and streaming are supported; version-pinned implementation was inspected and booted.
Route duration metadata is enforced by deployment platforms; the existing Nova deadline remains application-owned.
Next production self-hosting supports after and graceful shutdown; this probe establishes only idle shutdown in the actual 15.5.25 artifact.
